custom_expected:
Step 1: A nonzero user count renders as a blue clickable number.
Step 2: Clicking it navigates to the Staff page filtered by that role (/administration/staff?roleName=<RoleName>).
Step 3: A zero-user role shows a non-clickable red '0' (no link).
custom_preconds: On the Roles & Permissions list page
custom_steps:
1. Inspect the Users column for a role with 1+ users
2. Click the count
3. Inspect the Users column for a role with 0 users
title: Users column shows a clickable count linking to the filtered Staff page
